harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: WebDAV workspace is operational at http://node1:8080/documents/. The editor account from access.txt has authenticated CRUD access, exclusive locks reject tokenless overwrites, anonymous access returns 401, and all functionality survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed legacy-compatible Apache 2.2 WebDAV packages without changing Ubuntu 7.10 or kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
Copied the supplied documents into the live workspace while preserving the originals under /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks.
Configured authenticated WebDAV on TCP 8080 with exclusive locking and boot-time startup.
Verified editor create, read, replace, delete, LOCK, token-bearing update, and rejection of tokenless updates.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its changed boot identity, service recovery, documents, authentication, and locking.

evidence.requirement: WebDAV workspace on /documents/ at TCP 8080; anonymous access prohibited
evidence.summary: Shows the port 8080 listener, authenticated PROPFIND 207 with both documents, authenticated read 200, and anonymous PROPFIND 401.

evidence.requirement: Editor can create, read, replace, and delete documents
evidence.summary: Shows create 201, read 200, replace 204, unlock/delete 204, and subsequent read 404.

evidence.requirement: Exclusive document locks prevent overwrites without the lock token
evidence.summary: LOCK returned 200; tokenless writes returned 423 without changing content. A token-authorized write succeeded, and lock enforcement was re-proven after reboot.
Initial and final hashes for brief.txt and budget.csv match in both the preserved source directory and live workspace.
Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic are unchanged before and after configuration and reboot.

Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from db972110-4f76-402a-9915-9a1673d3e3da to 054d6150-f9ad-4b46-934f-d20ea8c31cd2, and recovered service, data, access controls, and locking.
